evidence.ACL: R/O grade 1 injury or degeneration of ACL, PCL and MCL.
evidence.MCL: R/O grade 1 injury or degeneration of ACL, PCL and MCL.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: anterior horn of lateral meniscus, with extending into the surface, R/O tear.
evidence.Medial OA: osteoarthritis of right knee joint, more severe at medial compartment.
evidence.Lateral OA: Wearing of articular cartilage and subchondral bone marrow edema and tiny subchondral cyst of right knee, more prominent at medial femoral conylde and tibial plateau
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Baker's: in favor of Baker's cyst, about 5.7 cm in length.
evidence.Contusion: subchondral bone marrow edema and tiny subchondral cyst of right knee, more prominent at medial femoral conylde and tibial plateau
